description_en: Queries the status of the virtual private cloud (VPC) firewall switch module for a pay-as-you-go user
description_zh: 查询按量付费用户VPC边界开关模块状态
kebab_example: aliyun cloudfw describe-postpay-user-vpc-status --instance-id cfw_elasticity_public_cn-000000000000 --lang zh --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribePostpayUserVpcStatus

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Cloud Firewall instance
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The language of the content within the response. Valid values:

zh (default): Chinese.
en: English
parameters.help_zh:
接收消息的语言类型。取值：

zh（默认）：中文。
en：英文
parameters.name: lang

Status.description_en:
The status of the Cloud Firewall VPC firewall switch module. Valid values:

open: The module is enabled.
init: The module is being enabled.
closed: The module is not enabled
Status.description_zh:
云防火墙VPC边界开关模块状态。取值：

open：模块已开启。
init：模块开启中。
closed：模块未开启

UnprotectedDate.description_en: The number of days during which protection is not enabled. This parameter is valid only when the module is enabled
UnprotectedDate.description_zh: 未开启防护的天数。仅当模块开启时，该参数有效
